name: flipud
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::flipud(Tensor self) -> Tensor. Reverses the order of slices along the first dimension and materializes a fresh output. The correctness suite covers zero-size and higher-rank tensors, floating, integer, boolean and complex dtypes, transposed, sliced, expanded and channels-last inputs, autograd, source non-mutation and rejection of a zero-dimensional input.
